ei.title: Liberal vs Confucian Views on Family and Equality
ei.subject: 10월_2025 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Liberal vs Confucian Views on Family and Equality

fullPassage: Within liberal culture, the value of fair equality of opportunity for individuals outweighs the preservation of the family's integrity. In contrast, for Confucian culture, while seeking fair equality of opportunity for individuals is important, the family assumes a fundamental role in human flourishing, and living within a family institution is considered the essential way of life. Individuals are primarily understood as family members before they are regarded as state citizens. Therefore, for Confucians, the family possesses inherent value that should never be abandoned, even if it results in certain societal inequalities. Some cultures, like the liberal one, may choose to impose increasing restrictions on the role of families and implement more egalitarian government programs for education, healthcare, and other positive rights in society in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity. On the other hand, other cultures, like the Confucian one, may prefer to primarily assign welfare responsibilities to the family, accepting inequalities stemming from the existence of the family as long as everyone's basic freedoms and rights are safeguarded in the state.

questions.passage: Within liberal culture, the value of fair equality of opportunity for individuals (A)[outweighs / underestimates] the preservation of the family's integrity. In contrast, for Confucian culture, while seeking fair equality of opportunity for individuals is important, the family assumes a (B)[fundamental / trivial] role in human flourishing, and living within a family institution is considered the essential way of life. Individuals are primarily understood as family members before they are regarded as state citizens. Therefore, for Confucians, the family possesses inherent value that should never be (C)[abandoned / embraced], even if it results in certain societal inequalities. Some cultures, like the liberal one, may choose to impose increasing restrictions on the role of families and implement more egalitarian government programs for education, healthcare, and other positive rights in society in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity. On the other hand, other cultures, like the Confucian one, may prefer to primarily assign welfare responsibilities to the family, accepting inequalities stemming from the existence of the family as long as everyone's basic freedoms and rights are safeguarded in the state.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) outweighs=능가하다, (B) fundamental=근본적인, (C) abandoned=버려진
det.analysis:
✅ ① outweighs — fundamental — abandoned: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② underestimates — fundamental — abandoned: (A) underestimates(과소평가하다)는 outweighs(능가하다)와 다름
❌ ③ outweighs — trivial — abandoned: (B) trivial(사소한)은 fundamental(근본적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ outweighs — fundamental — embraced: (C) embraced(수용된)는 abandoned(버려진)의 반의어
det.tip: outweighs the preservation / a fundamental role / never be abandoned

questions.passage: Within liberal culture, the value of fair equality of opportunity for individuals outweighs the (A)[preservation / destruction] of the family's integrity. In contrast, for Confucian culture, while seeking fair equality of opportunity for individuals is important, the family assumes a fundamental role in human flourishing, and living within a family institution is considered the essential way of life. Individuals are (B)[primarily / rarely] understood as family members before they are regarded as state citizens. Therefore, for Confucians, the family possesses inherent value that should never be abandoned, even if it results in certain societal inequalities. Some cultures, like the liberal one, may choose to (C)[impose / relax] increasing restrictions on the role of families and implement more egalitarian government programs for education, healthcare, and other positive rights in society in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity. On the other hand, other cultures, like the Confucian one, may prefer to primarily assign welfare responsibilities to the family, accepting inequalities stemming from the existence of the family as long as everyone's basic freedoms and rights are safeguarded in the state.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) preservation=보존, (B) primarily=주로, (C) impose=부과하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① destruction — primarily — impose: (A) destruction(파괴)은 preservation(보존)의 반의어
❌ ② preservation — rarely — impose: (B) rarely(드물게)는 primarily(주로)의 반의어
❌ ③ preservation — primarily — relax: (C) relax(완화하다)는 impose(부과하다)의 반의어
✅ ④ preservation — primarily — impose: 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: the preservation of / primarily understood / impose increasing restrictions

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) inherent=내재적인, (B) egalitarian=평등주의적인, (C) stemming=~에서 비롯된
det.analysis:
❌ ① negligible — egalitarian — stemming: (A) negligible(무시할 만한)은 inherent(내재적인)와 의미가 다름
❌ ② inherent — authoritarian — stemming: (B) authoritarian(권위주의적인)은 egalitarian(평등주의적인)의 반의어
❌ ③ inherent — egalitarian — independent: (C) independent(독립적인)는 stemming(비롯된)과 의미가 다름
✅ ④ inherent — egalitarian — stemming: 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: inherent value / egalitarian government programs / inequalities stemming from

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '가족이 내재적 가치를 지니므로 결코 버려져서는 안 된다' 맥락. maintained(유지된)는 abandoned(버려진)의 반의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① outweighs — 원문 일치. '기회의 균등이 가족의 온전성보다 더 중요하다(outweighs)'에 적절
❌ ② fundamental — 원문 일치. '가족이 근본적인(fundamental) 역할을 한다'에 적절
✅ ③ maintained — 원문 abandoned(버려진). maintained(유지된)로 바꾸면 '결코 유지되어서는 안 된다'가 되어 문맥과 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ inequalities — 원문 일치. '사회적 불평등(inequalities)을 초래하더라도'에 적절
det.tip: should never be abandoned — 결코 버려져서는 안 된다(abandoned)

det.korean: '모든 이의 기본 자유와 권리가 보호되는 한' 맥락. compromised(훼손된)는 safeguarded(보호된)의 반의어
det.analysis:

❌ ③ progressive: progressive(진보적인)는 사회 방향성이지 평등의 반대가 아님
❌ ④ communal: communal(공동의)은 평등과 유사한 방향
det.tip: egalitarian(평등주의적인) ↔ hierarchical(위계적인)

questions.passage:
(A) The family <u>assumes</u> a fundamental role in human flourishing according to Confucian culture.
(B) Everyone <u>assumes</u> that the meeting will be postponed until next week.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 assumes가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) assumes=떠맡다/차지하다(동사), (B) assumes=추측하다/가정하다(동사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 추측하다 — (B) 떠맡다: 의미가 뒤바뀜
✅ ② (A) 떠맡다 — (B) 추측하다: (A)는 역할을 떠맡다, (B)는 추측하다 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 가장하다 — (B) 책임지다: (A)는 역할 수행이지 위장이 아님, (B)는 추측이지 책임이 아님
❌ ④ (A) 차지하다 — (B) 위장하다: (B)에 위장 의미는 부적절
det.tip: (A) assume a role = 역할을 떠맡다 vs (B) assume that~ = ~라고 추측하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to be greater in importance or significance than something else"

det.korean: outweigh=~보다 더 중요하다: 다른 것보다 중요성이나 의미가 더 크다
det.analysis:
❌ ① implement: implement(시행하다)는 실행에 관한 것
❌ ② safeguard: safeguard(보호하다)는 보존에 관한 것
❌ ③ flourish: flourish(번영하다)는 성장에 관한 것
✅ ④ outweigh: outweigh(~보다 더 중요하다)는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: outweigh = to be greater in importance

questions.passage: The family possesses inherent value that should never be abandoned, even if it results in certain __________ (society) inequalities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: society → societal: 명사(inequalities) 앞에 형용사 필요
det.analysis: certain __________ (society) inequalities — 명사 inequalities 앞에 형용사가 필요. societal(사회적인)
det.tip: societal inequalities — 명사 society → 형용사 societal

questions.passage: Individuals are primarily understood as family members before they are __________ (regard) as state citizens.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: regard → regarded: 수동태(are ___) 문맥에서 과거분사 필요
det.analysis: they are __________ (regard) as state citizens — 수동태 are + 과거분사가 필요. regarded(간주되다)
det.tip: are regarded as — 동사 regard → 과거분사 regarded (수동태)

questions.passage: Within liberal culture, the value of __________ for individuals outweighs the preservation of the family's integrity. In contrast, for Confucian culture, while seeking fair equality of opportunity for individuals is important, the family assumes a fundamental role in human flourishing, and living within a family institution is considered the essential way of life. Individuals are primarily understood as family members before they are regarded as state citizens. Therefore, for Confucians, the family possesses inherent value that should never be abandoned, even if it results in certain societal inequalities. Some cultures, like the liberal one, may choose to impose increasing restrictions on the role of families and implement more egalitarian government programs for education, healthcare, and other positive rights in society in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity. On the other hand, other cultures, like the Confucian one, may prefer to primarily assign welfare responsibilities to the family, accepting inequalities stemming from the existence of the family as long as everyone's basic freedoms and rights are safeguarded in the state.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기회의 공정한 균등 추구에서 (자유주의 문화의 궁극적 목적)
det.analysis:
❌ ① strict moral discipline — 도덕적 규율은 본문 맥락에 없음
❌ ② economic independence — 경제적 독립은 본문에서 논의하지 않음
❌ ③ cultural diversity — 문화적 다양성은 본문의 핵심 주제가 아님
✅ ④ fair equality of opportunity — 원문 일치. 'in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity' ←정답
det.tip: in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity — 기회의 공정한 균등 추구에서

questions.passage: Within liberal culture, the value of fair equality of opportunity for individuals outweighs the preservation of the family's integrity. In contrast, for Confucian culture, while seeking fair equality of opportunity for individuals is important, the family assumes a fundamental role in human flourishing, and living within a family institution is considered the essential way of life. Individuals are primarily understood as family members before they are regarded as state citizens. Therefore, for Confucians, the family possesses inherent value that should never be abandoned, even if it results in certain societal inequalities. Some cultures, like the liberal one, may choose to impose increasing restrictions on the role of families and implement more egalitarian government programs for education, healthcare, and other positive rights in society in the pursuit of fair equality of opportunity. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모든 이의 기본 자유와 권리가 보호되는 한 (유교 문화가 가족에 의한 불평등을 수용하는 조건)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 모든 가족이 동등한 정부 자금 지원 — 유교 문화는 정부 프로그램이 아닌 가족 중심
❌ ② 정부가 모든 불평등 제거 — 유교 문화는 불평등을 수용하며 제거하지 않음
✅ ③ 모든 이의 기본 자유와 권리 보호 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 모든 시민이 가족 결정에 참여 — 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: as long as everyone's basic freedoms and rights are safeguarded — 기본 자유와 권리가 보호되는 한
